description: This file defines a custom matcher class `MacroCallParameterStringValueMatcher` used for testing purposes, specifically to match string values in test assertions within the `org.apache.ofbiz.widget.renderer.macro` package.

classes.name: MacroCallParameterStringValueMatcher

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the matcher with the expected string value.
